question: Rukmini Devi is regarded as one of the most distinguished artists of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rukmini Devi** is regarded as one of the most distinguished artists of **Bharatanatyam**.
 
• She played a crucial role in the revival of **Bharatanatyam** in the 20th century, which was earlier known as **Sadhir**.
 
• Rukmini Devi founded the **Kalakshetra Foundation** in Chennai in 1936, which is dedicated to the preservation and teaching of Bharatanatyam and other Indian arts.
 
• Her efforts helped to elevate Bharatanatyam from a form of entertainment to a respected classical art form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam** is one of the oldest classical dance forms in India, originating from **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, intricate footwork, hand gestures, and facial expressions.
 
• The dance form is traditionally performed by women, and it expresses South Indian religious themes and spiritual ideas, particularly of Shaivism, Vaishnavism, and Shaktism.
 
• Rukmini Devi's contribution to Bharatanatyam includes the introduction of new themes and the exclusion of certain elements that she deemed inappropriate, thereby making it more acceptable to the modern audience.
